name: Knitting stitch math write-up (Klein four group)

mentions.name: Knitting stitch math write-up (Klein four group)
mentions.description: A write-up exploring the mathematics behind knitting stitches, bridging abstract algebra (the Klein four group) with real-world knitting and rediscovering obscure stitches.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working out some of the math behind knitting stitches and made a little write up linked here:

https://asunder.co/app/knit/articles/klein-four-group

It's quite basic but figuring out the real-world bridge between algebra and knitting and re-discovering obscure stitches is quite satisfying.
